# Disagreement Log — GTH_104

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 104
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 104 | "in what have I been defeated" | "wherein have I been found wanting" | "What battle have I lost?" | *kalei*: defeated vs. found wanting vs. battle lost |
| 2 | 104 | "comes out of the bridal chamber" | "has come out of the bridal chamber" | "leaves the bridal chamber" | Bridegroom's exit: present vs. perfect vs. leaves |

**Total disagreements: 2**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "in what have I been defeated" (*kalei* as defeat/being overcome) and "comes out of" (simple present, following the Coptic aspect).
